verdict.rationale: A probe confirms HubSpot documents an official MCP server at developers.hubspot.com/ai-tools/mcp, so the product itself offers this capability. The pack contains only that one-line probe, so how well it works and what it covers are unproven. Missing for 10: details of the exposed tools or Marketing Hub scope, connection and authentication setup, supported MCP clients, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
